lines.zh: 蜡翅扫过石阶，我照例巡行。
lines.en: My waxen wings sweep the stairs on my patrol.

lines.zh: 我沿圣所的墙根缓缓滑行。
lines.en: I glide slowly along the sanctum's outer wall.

lines.zh: 每一块砖都记在我的蜡纹里。
lines.en: Every brick is written into my waxen grain.

lines.zh: 我飞过蜂巢，翅膀不敢碰它。
lines.en: I pass the hive without letting a wing touch it.

lines.zh: 三百年了，这条路线没变。
lines.en: Three hundred years, and this route has not changed.

lines.zh: 蜡身太重，转弯要早半拍。
lines.en: My body is heavy wax, so I turn half a beat early.

lines.zh: 石路上的裂缝是我压出来的。
lines.en: The cracks in the walkway were pressed there by me.

lines.zh: 我绕开那棵老蜜树，它比我老。
lines.en: I go around the old honey tree; it is older than I.

lines.zh: 巡行时我不停数着蜂群。
lines.en: On patrol I keep counting the passing bees.

lines.zh: 我掠过水池，倒影纹丝不动。
lines.en: I skim the pool, and my reflection does not ripple.

lines.zh: 蜡翼发出低低的嗡鸣。
lines.en: A low hum rises from my waxen wings.

lines.zh: 我在门前停一停，再往前飞。
lines.en: I pause at the gate, then drift onward.

lines.zh: 这条廊道只给蜜蜂和我走。
lines.en: This corridor is walked only by bees and me.

lines.zh: 我飞得慢，但从不偏离墙线。
lines.en: I fly slow, but I never leave the wall line.

lines.zh: 蜡液滴在地上，我不管它。
lines.en: Wax drips to the floor and I pay it no mind.

lines.zh: 我把影子投在墙上，慢慢移。
lines.en: I cast my shadow on the wall and move it slowly.

lines.zh: 我悬在光柱里，一动不动。
lines.en: I hang in the light shaft without moving.

lines.zh: 蜡在慢慢硬化，我不去管它。
lines.en: The wax hardens slowly; I let it.

lines.zh: 有人碰过门框，蜡上有指纹。
lines.en: Someone touched the frame; there is a print in wax.

lines.zh: 我闭眼听蜂鸣，那是唯一的声音。
lines.en: I close my eyes; the bees are the only sound.

lines.zh: 圣所的地板凉，我的蜡也凉。
lines.en: The sanctum floor is cold, and so is my wax.

lines.zh: 我从不需要睡眠，只需要站岗。
lines.en: I never need sleep, only the standing watch.

lines.zh: 一只蜜蜂落在我肩上，我让它停。
lines.en: A bee lands on my shoulder, and I let it stay.

lines.zh: 我数着穹顶的蜂巢格数。
lines.en: I count the honeycomb cells in the vault.

lines.zh: 蜡缝里封着一根旧羽毛。
lines.en: An old feather is sealed inside a seam of wax.

lines.zh: 我在等，等得比石头还久。
lines.en: I am waiting, and I have waited longer than stone.

lines.zh: 圣所安静得像没醒过。
lines.en: The sanctum is quiet as if it never woke.

lines.zh: 一滴蜡从指尖落下，停住了。
lines.en: A drop of wax falls from my finger and stops.

lines.zh: 你不是蜜蜂，站住。
lines.en: You are not a bee. Stand still.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛只认蜡和蜂翅。
lines.en: My eyes know only wax and bee wings.

lines.zh: 你身上的气味很陌生。
lines.en: The scent on you is not from here.

lines.zh: 我转过头，蜡颈发出轻响。
lines.en: I turn my head; my wax neck creaks.

lines.zh: 你已经进到圣所的边线了。
lines.en: You have already crossed the sanctum's edge.

lines.zh: 蜡做的眼睛，已经刻下你的影子。
lines.en: My waxen eyes have carved your shadow into memory.

lines.zh: 抬眼看我，别低头。
lines.en: Look up at me. Do not lower your eyes.

lines.zh: 蜂群没有为你让路。
lines.en: The bees did not part for you.

lines.zh: 我数过你，只有一个。
lines.en: I have counted you. There is only one.

lines.zh: 站在这道光里，让我看清。
lines.en: Stand in this light and let me see you.

lines.zh: 你的剑弹开了，蜡上没痕。
lines.en: Your blade bounced off; the wax is unmarked.

lines.zh: 我无法被伤害，你却累了。
lines.en: I cannot be hurt, yet you are tired.

lines.zh: 这一下连蜡屑都没削掉。
lines.en: That did not even chip the wax.

lines.zh: 打吧，我等着你手酸。
lines.en: Keep hitting. I will wait for your arm to tire.

lines.zh: 我的身体是远古的咒，不是肉。
lines.en: My body is an ancient spell, not flesh.

lines.zh: 你若打碎我，圣所会塌一半。
lines.en: Break me and half the sanctum falls.

lines.zh: 疼这种感觉，我没装进去。
lines.en: Pain was never built into me.

lines.zh: 你的武器在发抖，不是我在抖。
lines.en: Your weapon trembles, not I.

lines.zh: 蜡纹晃了一下，马上又定住。
lines.en: My grain flickers once, then settles.

lines.zh: 这一击我记在砖上了。
lines.en: I have recorded that blow on the bricks.

lines.zh: 我不吃蜜，我只是守着它。
lines.en: I do not eat honey; I only guard it.

lines.zh: 你把花举高也没用。
lines.en: Raising flowers at me changes nothing.

lines.zh: 蜡身没有饥饿这种感觉。
lines.en: A wax body has no such thing as hunger.

lines.zh: 食物留给蜜蜂，我不需要。
lines.en: Leave the food for bees; I need none.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手，不是盯着食物。
lines.en: I watch your hand, not the food in it.

lines.zh: 你的甜味盖不住陌生气味。
lines.en: Your sweetness cannot hide an unfamiliar smell.

lines.zh: 我曾经也会饿，现在不会了。
lines.en: I used to feel hunger. I do not anymore.

lines.zh: 收起来吧，别在我面前晃。
lines.en: Put it away. Do not wave it at me.

lines.zh: 我不为蜜折腰，只为圣所折腰。
lines.en: I bow to the sanctum, never to honey.

lines.zh: 你喂不了一块石头。
lines.en: You cannot feed a statue.

lines.zh: 撞上了，你就别再往前。
lines.en: You have hit me; go no further.

lines.zh: 我这一下还算轻。
lines.en: That one was still a gentle nudge.

lines.zh: 蜡肩擦过你的胸口了吧。
lines.en: My wax shoulder grazed your chest, did it not?

lines.zh: 退开三步，我数到三。
lines.en: Step back three paces. I count to three.

lines.zh: 你被弹开的样子很干净。
lines.en: You bounced away rather cleanly.

lines.zh: 路上的碎石是我的刹车。
lines.en: The loose stones are my brakes.

lines.zh: 别贴着我走，蜡会黏人。
lines.en: Do not walk against me; wax sticks.

lines.zh: 我停下时，地面会沉一寸。
lines.en: When I stop, the ground sinks an inch.

lines.zh: 你挡住了巡行的路线。
lines.en: You are blocking the patrol line.

lines.zh: 再撞一次，速度会翻倍。
lines.en: Bump me again and my speed doubles.

lines.zh: 我是唯一的一尊，没有同伴。
lines.en: I am the only one; there is no mate for me.

lines.zh: 蜡不会繁衍，只会硬化。
lines.en: Wax does not breed; it only hardens.

lines.zh: 当年的匠人早就化成灰了。
lines.en: The artisan who made me is long ash.

lines.zh: 我守的是这座圣所，不是婚约。
lines.en: I guard this sanctuary, not any marriage.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣是这座圣所。
lines.en: My companion is this sanctum.

lines.zh: 蜂后有很多孩子，我一个也没有。
lines.en: The queen has many children; I have none.

lines.zh: 同类的脚步声，我没听过。
lines.en: I have never heard the footsteps of my own kind.

lines.zh: 孤独对蜡来说不算什么。
lines.en: Loneliness means little to wax.

lines.zh: 你若要陪我站岗，就站好。
lines.en: If you would keep watch with me, stand properly.

lines.zh: 我不需要血脉，只需要门还关着。
lines.en: I need no bloodline, only a shut gate.

lines.zh: 我的手指是蜡做的，拿不住。
lines.en: My fingers are wax; they cannot hold things.

lines.zh: 地上的东西不归我管。
lines.en: What lies on the ground is not mine to take.

lines.zh: 我把东西留给蜜蜂搬走。
lines.en: I leave it for the bees to carry off.

lines.zh: 蜡掌一合，东西就陷进去。
lines.en: My wax palm closes, and things sink in.

lines.zh: 我不收藏，圣所里已经够满。
lines.en: I collect nothing; the sanctum is full enough.

lines.zh: 那枚硬币是闯入者掉的，不是我的。
lines.en: That coin was dropped by an intruder, not me.

lines.zh: 我连自己的碎片都不捡。
lines.en: I do not even gather my own fallen pieces.

lines.zh: 别把杂物放在我的路线上。
lines.en: Do not leave clutter along my patrol line.

lines.zh: 我只捡回被撞歪的砖。
lines.en: I only pick up the bricks I knocked crooked.

lines.zh: 拿走吧，我不需要它。
lines.en: Take it. I have no use for it.

lines.zh: 目标已定，就在庭中央。
lines.en: Target fixed, there in the middle of the court.

lines.zh: 你踏进视线的瞬间就够了。
lines.en: The instant you entered my sight was enough.

lines.zh: 我记下你的方向了。
lines.en: I have your direction written down.

lines.zh: 蜡里的旧魔法开始转。
lines.en: The old magic in my wax starts to turn.

lines.zh: 不是蜂，就会被我追。
lines.en: Not a bee, and I will chase.

lines.zh: 你往哪退，我都看得见。
lines.en: Wherever you retreat, I see it.

lines.zh: 战斗程序醒过来了。
lines.en: The combat rite has woken.

lines.zh: 我选定你了，别换位置。
lines.en: I have chosen you; do not change places.

lines.zh: 蜂群替我圈出了你。
lines.en: The bees have circled you out for me.

lines.zh: 这一击的路线我已经画好。
lines.en: I have already drawn the line of this strike.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，蜡翼收紧。
lines.en: I lower myself and fold my wax wings in.

lines.zh: 起冲之前，我先静一息。
lines.en: Before the charge, I hold one breath.

lines.zh: 速度在蜡里一点点堆起来。
lines.en: Speed gathers inside the wax, bit by bit.

lines.zh: 我听见自己越来越响。
lines.en: I hear myself getting louder.

lines.zh: 你最好现在就跑。
lines.en: You had better run now.

lines.zh: 路线上的脆石已经松了。
lines.en: The brittle stone on my path is already loose.

lines.zh: 瞄准不需要眼睛，蜡会告诉我。
lines.en: Aiming needs no eyes; the wax tells me.

lines.zh: 我的重量开始向前倾。
lines.en: My weight begins to lean forward.

lines.zh: 一秒之后，这里会空出一条道。
lines.en: In one second there will be a clear lane here.

lines.zh: 别眨眼，你会错过起跑。
lines.en: Do not blink; you will miss the start.

lines.zh: 撞碎你，比撞碎砖容易。
lines.en: Breaking you is easier than breaking brick.

lines.zh: 速度就是我的拳头。
lines.en: Speed is my fist.

lines.zh: 你被压在蜡和地面之间了。
lines.en: You are pinned between wax and the ground.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我连石阶一起撞坏了。
lines.en: That charge broke the steps along with you.

lines.zh: 蜂甲救了你半条命。
lines.en: Bee armor saved you half a life.

lines.zh: 我碾过去，从不回头。
lines.en: I roll over and never look back.

lines.zh: 你的盾在蜡面前像纸。
lines.en: Your shield is paper before wax.

lines.zh: 墙已经塌了，你也一样。
lines.en: The wall came down, and so will you.

lines.zh: 我的撞击有古老的重量。
lines.en: My ramming carries an ancient weight.

lines.zh: 倒下之前，先看清我的蜡纹。
lines.en: Before you fall, look at my waxen grain.

lines.zh: 蜡壳裂开，我又醒了。
lines.en: The wax shell cracks, and I wake again.

lines.zh: 圣所的门一响，我就睁眼。
lines.en: When the sanctum gate rings, I open my eyes.

lines.zh: 谁把我从长眠里叫起来。
lines.en: Who called me out of the long sleep?

lines.zh: 光柱落在我身上，暖也没用。
lines.en: The light shaft falls on me, warm and useless.

lines.zh: 我站起来了，砖缝里掉着蜡屑。
lines.en: I stand; wax flakes fall from the seams.

lines.zh: 守卫的职责又回到我身上。
lines.en: The duty of the watch returns to me.

lines.zh: 蜂群在我头顶绕了三圈。
lines.en: The bees circled my head three times.

lines.zh: 这次的入侵者在哪。
lines.en: Where is the intruder this time?

lines.zh: 我的眼睛先亮，身体后动。
lines.en: My eyes light first; the body follows.

lines.zh: 圣所又需要一尊会动的蜡像。
lines.en: The sanctum needs a moving statue again.

lines.zh: 火烤软了我的蜡面，但只一层。
lines.en: Fire softens my wax, one layer only.

lines.zh: 我从高处坠下，蜡身裂了细纹。
lines.en: I fell from height; fine cracks run through my wax.

lines.zh: 水浸进蜡缝，我沉得很慢。
lines.en: Water seeps into my seams; I sink slowly.

lines.zh: 爆炸的气浪把我推偏了半步。
lines.en: The blast pushed me half a step off line.

lines.zh: 箭插在蜡里，像根旧羽毛。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my wax like an old feather.

lines.zh: 魔法打在我身上，只起一层雾。
lines.en: Magic strikes me and only raises a mist.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，但蜡在变脆。
lines.en: I do not eat, yet my wax grows brittle.

lines.zh: 雷落在我头顶，蜡面烧黑了。
lines.en: Lightning struck my crown and scorched the wax.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有砖，也没有圣所。
lines.en: There are no bricks in the void, no sanctum.
